name: Singularity
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 5, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 20-foot radius burst
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lift against all creatures that are within the area of the burst. However, at the center of the area is a dark sphere which pulls all affected creatures to the center of the area, as much as possible. Any creature that enters the area must make a save or be affected.
